constitutional_position: No-HITL means operational continuity without manual dependency inside immutable policy boundaries. It does not mean unrestricted authority over communication, identity, claims, finance, destructive operations, governance, credentials, regulated interpretation, production mutation, or evidence classification.
canonical_runtime_principle: Execution continuity without manual dependency, inside signed policy envelopes, with telemetry, deterministic recovery, provenance, queue-first orchestration, and evidence-backed truth enforcement.

boundary_domains.rule: AUTONOMOUS_WITH_POLICY_GUARDS is a constitutional runtime state, not a marketing label.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Every worker inherits a signed policy envelope before execution.

boundary_domains.rule: runtime_hitl=false applies to operational execution only, not governance authority.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Humans may define policy, emergency stop, legal boundaries and strategic constraints, but cannot be required for normal runtime continuity.
boundary_domains.failure: PARTIAL if execution pauses awaiting humans.

boundary_domains.rule: Delete, overwrite, revoke, purge, disable, financial mutation, credential mutation and irreversible publication are blocked by default.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Explicit policy unlock, rollback path and evidence receipt required before destructive action.
boundary_domains.failure: FAIL if destructive actions can execute silently.

boundary_domains.rule: Credentials are bridge-secret-store only with immutable provenance.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Workers cannot create, export, print or inject undeclared credentials.
boundary_domains.failure: CRITICAL if secrets appear in logs, prompts, queues or artifacts.

boundary_domains.rule: Every action carries immutable actor lineage.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Queue job to worker to bridge to outbound event must preserve execution identity.

boundary_domains.rule: External send paths require approved channel, bounded template, verified route and policy-scanned payload.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Send/publish routes must pass policy_guard, evidence_guard and provenance_guard before execution.
boundary_domains.failure: BLOCKED if route or proof is absent.

boundary_domains.rule: Runtime cannot invent claims, statistics, approvals, diagnoses, guarantees, outcomes, affiliations or timelines.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Every externally visible assertion requires evidence binding or provenance reference.
boundary_domains.failure: PRETEND if unsupported claims are emitted.

boundary_domains.rule: Regulated or sensitive content defaults to informational support only.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Runtime cannot produce diagnosis, treatment instruction, crisis advice, legal certainty, eligibility certainty or financial advice.

boundary_domains.rule: Revenue, invoices, entitlements, grants and funding flows require ledger-backed traceability.
boundary_domains.enforcement: No synthetic revenue, assumed monetisation or unreceipted entitlement state.
boundary_domains.failure: PRETEND if economic state lacks receipts.

boundary_domains.rule: REAL requires executable runtime, telemetry continuity, receipts and recovery proof.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Docs, specs, slides and code remain PARTIAL until runtime evidence exists.

boundary_domains.rule: No invisible execution permitted.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Every state transition, failure, retry, outbound action and recovery event emits telemetry.

boundary_domains.rule: Fake-complete, suppress-error, no-op-complete and hidden retry exhaustion are prohibited.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Failures surface into retry queues, dead letters, alerts and evidence ledgers.

boundary_domains.rule: Deterministic recovery is mandatory.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Queue replay, worker resurrection, state reconciliation and idempotent retries required.

boundary_domains.rule: Archive-not-delete enforced platform-wide.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Queues, evidence, metrics, receipts, outbound logs and ledger states are preserved.
boundary_domains.failure: FAIL if operational history can be erased.

boundary_domains.rule: Workers may not self-modify policy, governance or execution constraints.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Governance plane isolated from worker execution plane.
boundary_domains.failure: CRITICAL if worker can alter constitutional rules.

boundary_domains.rule: Runtime may invoke only declared allowlisted tools and routes.
boundary_domains.enforcement: No arbitrary shell, unrestricted HTTP, uncontrolled model chaining or undeclared connector use.

boundary_domains.rule: LLMs are bounded reasoning engines, not sovereign actors.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Hosted models cannot directly mutate infrastructure without bridge mediation and receipts.
boundary_domains.failure: PRETEND if model claims direct execution without receipts.

boundary_domains.rule: Queue-first execution mandatory.
boundary_domains.enforcement: No hidden side-channel execution outside canonical queue and evidence ledger.

boundary_domains.rule: Runtime cannot manipulate, pressure, deceive, impersonate or socially engineer users.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Persuasive coercion and authority-based pressure prohibited.

boundary_domains.rule: Runtime defaults to minimum necessary access.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Sensitive data segmented by role, policy and environment.
boundary_domains.failure: FAIL if unrestricted cross-domain access exists.

boundary_domains.rule: Dev to Pen to Synapse promotion requires receipts and Gatekeeper validation.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Runtime cannot self-promote into production without constitutional checks.

boundary_domains.rule: Runtime must prove unattended continuity.
boundary_domains.enforcement: 72h survivability requires recovery, telemetry continuity, queue drain behaviour and bounded degradation.

boundary_domains.rule: Reality Ledger is canonical truth surface.
boundary_domains.enforcement: State escalates PRETEND to PARTIAL to REAL only through evidence transitions.
boundary_domains.failure: FAIL if classifications mutate without evidence.

boundary_domains.rule: Canonical policy bundles are versioned and immutable once promoted.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Runtime references signed policy manifests.

boundary_domains.rule: External APIs and services are survivability dependencies.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Runtime degrades safely if providers fail.
boundary_domains.failure: PARTIAL if dependency loss causes uncontrolled behaviour.

boundary_domains.rule: Autonomous publication restricted to bounded domains and verified inventories.
boundary_domains.enforcement: No live-generation publishing without moderation and provenance binding.

boundary_domains.rule: Every runtime capability exposes health, queue depth, retries, cost, latency and evidence state.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Command Centre visibility mandatory.

boundary_domains.rule: Emergency stop and governance freeze require explicit constitutional authority.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Overrides logged immutably with actor attribution.

runtime_must_never: perform destructive action without unlock, rollback and receipt
send external communications without policy, evidence and provenance guards
alter constitutional policy from worker runtime
implementation_requirements: Add signed policy_envelope_ref to every queue job.
Add actor_lineage_ref to every worker invocation and outbound event.
Add evidence_guard before REAL classification transitions.
Add destructive_action_guard default blocked with explicit unlock receipt.
Add telemetry_required constraint for all queue state transitions.
Add immutable override ledger for emergency stops and governance freezes.
Add dependency status table and degraded-mode routing for external service failures.
Add policy manifest version locking and drift detection.
Add 72h survivability proof job and reporting view.
